desc: Ideation: fixed-k binary DP over 26 letters with adjacent-shift savings is the leading O(26n) approach.
Implement fixed-k 2-state DP (dp0/dp1), unary |c_i - d_i|, edge saving min(excess_{i-1}, deficit_i), no 25->0 edge, best initialized to n.
Run the 3 official samples and confirm outputs 1, 0, 2.
Stress-test DP against a brute-force solver on random small strings / reduced alphabets — 1000 random cases matched, no counterexamples.
Performance-check the DP at n = 2*10^4 — runs well under time limit.
Confirmed only adjacent (distance-1) shifts ever yield a saving; distance>=2 equals delete+insert, so no carry/multi-edge model is needed.
